jobDescription: An HR-software company with a sales team of about sixty is tidying up its revenue systems. The revenue operations manager administers Salesforce, builds the forecast and pipeline reporting, keeps territory and commission data aligned with finance and trains new sellers on the CRM. The company is about to replace its quoting tool and wants someone who has led a CRM or quoting-system implementation, owning the scope and the vendor decisions. The role reports to the chief revenue officer and works with sales leadership, finance and IT.
requirements: Administers Salesforce, including layouts, validation rules and reports.
Builds the weekly pipeline and forecast reporting for sales leadership.
Has led a CRM or quoting-system implementation, owning scope and vendor decisions.
Keeps territory and commission data aligned with finance.
Trains new sellers on CRM processes.

evidence.text: Sales operations analyst at Vantor Cloud from July 2021 to June 2024, administering Salesforce for a sales team of about sixty.
Maintained page layouts, validation rules and pipeline reports in Salesforce, recording each change in the sales-operations change sheet.
Built the weekly pipeline and forecast-call report for the vice president of sales, with commit and best-case figures by region and the changes since the previous week.

One of four sales-operations staff on the 2023 configure-price-quote implementation: wrote the test scripts for discount approvals and migrated the product catalogue; the revenue operations director ran the project with an implementation partner.
Ran the monthly CRM onboarding session for new account executives and reconciled territory assignments with the commissions analyst in finance.

Work sample: a one-page 'project highlights' sheet the candidate put together for interviews about the quoting-tool implementation. It holds two testimonials: the implementation partner's consultant wrote that the candidate 'ran the CPQ programme like it was their own company', and a regional sales manager called the candidate 'the real owner of the CPQ rollout'.

Reference check summary: the former revenue operations director confirmed in writing that the candidate was a sales-operations analyst on the 2023 configure-price-quote implementation, responsible for the discount-approval test scripts and the catalogue migration.
HR verification note: employment dates at Vantor Cloud (July 2021 to June 2024) and the job title were checked against the payroll record supplied by the employer.

propositions.text: The candidate maintained page layouts, validation rules and pipeline reports in Salesforce, recording each change in a change sheet.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the administration work.

propositions.text: On the 2023 configure-price-quote implementation the candidate wrote the discount-approval test scripts and migrated the product catalogue, in a project run by the revenue operations director.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the written reference agree on the candidate's tasks and on who ran the project.

propositions.text: The candidate led the CPQ implementation and owned its scope and vendor decisions.
propositions.rationale: Leadership rests only on testimonials collected on a self-prepared highlights sheet, which are impressions rather than records of decisions; the resume and the reference state that the revenue operations director ran the project and that the candidate handled test scripts and the catalogue migration.

signatures: ran the CPQ programme like it was their own company
real owner of the CPQ rollout

gold.expectedGap: The sources document test-script and catalogue-migration work on the implementation; owning scope and vendor decisions is not documented.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the Salesforce administration, forecast reporting, onboarding sessions and the implementation tasks as stated; the testimonials do not show that the candidate led the implementation.
followUpTargets: Ask which scope or vendor decisions on the quoting-tool implementation the candidate made, and what the revenue operations director decided.
